description: List every built-in FlowSimp template. Use it when a starter diagram is a better fit than generating one from text. Takes no arguments. Returns JSON with a templates array of id, label, and editUrl. The ids are swimlane, decision-tree, user-flow, org-chart, flowchart, process, network, mind-map, data-flow, algorithm, bpmn, onboarding, and approval. Each editUrl opens that template in the editor. The list is fixed, and the call does not store or change anything.
name: list_templates
title: List templates
